title: Panics you didn't ask for
hints: Run the checks and read the panic messages: "index out of range [-1]" and "assignment to entry in nil map". The runtime panics on these mistakes.
Last must check for an empty slice before indexing. A Registry's map is nil in the zero value, and reading a nil map is fine but writing to one panics.
In Last: if len(xs) == 0 { return 0, false }.  In Add: if r.counts == nil { r.counts = map[string]int{} }
